# Learning TypeScript

> > Companion website for the O'Reilly book 'Learning TypeScript' by Josh Goldberg, featuring chapters, projects, and articles on TypeScript's type system.

This site provides comprehensive TypeScript learning resources including book chapters on type systems, interfaces, and advanced type operations, plus hands-on GitHub projects and in-depth articles. The content ranges from JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration basics to advanced topics like conditional types, template literals, and TSConfig optimization.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript type system
- Type annotations and inference
- Type checking and narrowing
- Interfaces and object types
- Conditional types
- Template literal types
- Advanced type operations
- TSConfig and compiler options
- Arrays and tuples
- Comment directives (@ts-expect-error)
- Classes and inheritance
- Type-safe error handling
- ECMAScript target configuration
- TypeScript Playground
- Jest testing with TypeScript

## Getting Started

- [Learning TypeScript](https://learningtypescript.com): Homepage for Learning TypeScript book by Josh Goldberg with O'Reilly
- [What is TypeScript?](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/what-is-typescript): Beginner guide explaining TypeScript as language, type checker, and toolset
- [From JavaScript to TypeScript](https://learningtypescript.com/from-javascript-to-typescript): Chapter on JavaScript's weaknesses & TypeScript's advantages for beginners
- [Projects](https://learningtypescript.com/projects): Hands-on exercises & coding challenges for each book chapter on GitHub

## Core Type System Concepts

- [The Type System](https://learningtypescript.com/the-type-system): Chapter covering TypeScript's type system, primitives, and type annotations
- [Interfaces](https://learningtypescript.com/interfaces): Chapter on interface properties, inheritance, merging, and index signatures
- [Arrays](https://learningtypescript.com/arrays): Chapter on array types, tuples, spreads, rests, and const assertions
- [Classes](https://learningtypescript.com/classes): Chapter on class methods, properties, interfaces, and inheritance in TS

## Advanced Type Operations

- [Type Operations](https://learningtypescript.com/type-operations): Advanced chapter on mapped types, conditional types, and template literals
- [The satisfies Operator](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/the-satisfies-operator): TypeScript 4.9 satisfies operator for improved type inference control
- [Narrowing Function Parameters With Rests And Tuples](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/narrowing-function-parameters-with-rests-and-tuples): Advanced techniques for dependent parameter types using tuples & rests
- [Extreme Explorations of TypeScript's Type System](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/extreme-explorations-of-typescripts-type-system): Turing Complete type system: advanced conditional types & type challenges

## Configuration & Tooling

- [Configuration Options](https://learningtypescript.com/configuration-options): Chapter on TSConfig files, tsc compiler, and TypeScript project settings
- [Why Increase Your TSConfig target](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/why-increase-your-tsconfig-target): Guide to compilerOptions.target for ECMAScript version & transpilation
- [Comment Directives](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/comment-directives): Guide to @ts-expect-error and @ts-ignore comment directives usage
- [Starters](https://learningtypescript.com/starters): Framework starter templates for Angular, Next.js, Remix, Vue, and React

## Articles & Deep Dives

- [Articles](https://learningtypescript.com/articles): Collection of TypeScript articles on features, syntax, and type checking
- [Why TypeScript Doesn't Include a throws Keyword](https://learningtypescript.com/articles/why-typescript-doesnt-include-a-throws-keyword): Article on throw types design decision comparing TypeScript to Java

## Practice Projects

- [Text Processor](https://learningtypescript.com/arrays/text-processor): Arrays chapter entree project: string manipulation & array transformations
- [The Narrow Trail](https://learningtypescript.com/unions-and-literals/the-narrow-trail): Unions chapter entree project: game logic with type narrowing exercises
- [Vacation Planning](https://learningtypescript.com/interfaces/vacation-planning): Interfaces chapter appetizer: structural object types practice exercise
- [Template Literal Type Shenanigans](https://learningtypescript.com/type-operations/template-literal-type-shenanigans): Type Operations appetizer: advanced template literal types exercises
- [Secret Messages](https://learningtypescript.com/configuration-options/secret-messages): Configuration Options appetizer: TSConfig compiler practice exercise
